text.en:
Barangays Bogo Calabat, Sebucang, Nopolan, Lower Bag-ong Tudela, Leonardo, Gumahan,
Mansanas, Nemenio, Moradje, Dawa, Tagaytay Hill, Litapan and Ebarle, all in the Municipality of Tambulig,
Province of Zamboanga Del Sur, are hereby detached and separated therefrom to form and constitute into a
distinct and independent municipality which is hereby created to be known as the Municipality of Josefina
without affecting in any manner the legal existence of the mother Municipality of Tambulig. The new
municipality shall be specifically bounded as follows:
"Beginning at a point marked "1" the existing barrio hall of Bogo Calabat, thence due south, 2,100 meters to
point "2", thence due west, 3,000 meters to point "3", thence due north 19,200 meters to point "4"; (the
intersection of Zamboanga del Norte and Zamboanga del Sur Provincial Boundary) thence due east following
the common boundary of Zamboanga del Sur and Zamboanga del Norte to a distance of 5,200 meters until it
intersects the provincial boundary of Misamis Occidental and Zamboanga del Sur to point "5"; thence due
south following the common provincial boundary of Misamis Occidental and Zamboanga del Sur to a distance
of 17,200 meters to point "6"; thence due west 1,250 meters to point "7"; thence due south 1,300 meters to
point "8"; thence due west 1,000 meters to point "9"; (identical to point 2) thence due north 2,100 meters to
point "1" the point of beginning."
The seat of the government of the newly created municipality shall be in Barangay Gumahan.

Except as hereinafter provided, all provisions of law, now or hereafter applicable to regular
municipalities, shall be applicable to the Municipality of Josefina.

The present elective municipal officials of the Municipality of Tambulig shall continue to
perform their duties as such officials in the newly created Municipality of Josefina until the municipal

officials of said municipality shall have been appointed by the President. Such officials so appointed shall
hold office until their successors shall have been elected in the regular elections for municipal officials
following the issuance of this Decree and shall have qualified, unless sooner removed at the pleasure of the
President. Such appointive officers and employees as may be necessary to organize or to complete the
government personnel of the Municipality of Josefina shall be appointed as provided for under existing laws.

Upon the effectivity of this Decree, the proportionate share of Josefina in the obligations, funds,
assets and other property of the Municipality of Tambulig shall be transferred by the President to the newly
created municipality upon the recommendation of the Commission on Audit.

All laws or parts of laws as well as all executive order or regulations inconsistent herewith are
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila this 11th day of November, in the year of Our Lord Nineteen Hundred and
Seventy-Seven.
